relations.subject: Albrecht Wezler
relations.evidence: die von Prof. A. Wezler verfaßte, höchst fehlerhafte Bearbeitung des Stenzler-Elementarbuches
relations.gloss_en: Wezler produced a highly flawed revision of Stenzler's Elementarbuch.

relations.subject: Richard Pischel
relations.role: revised (bearbeitet) the 7th edition (1902) of Stenzler's Elementarbuch
relations.evidence: die 7. Auflage 1902 ... die noch von Richard Pischel bearbeitet worden war
relations.gloss_en: The 7th edition (1902) was still revised by Richard Pischel.

relations.subject: Whitney
relations.role: showed that Stenzler's grammatical rule was invented
relations.evidence: obwohl Whitney bereits 1888 feststellte, daß diese "Regel" frei erfunden ist
relations.gloss_en: Whitney already established in 1888 that this 'rule' was purely invented.

relations.subject: Kielhorn
relations.role: adopted Stenzler's invented grammatical rule into his own grammar
relations.evidence: haben spätere Autoren (Kielhorn, Fick, Morgenroth usw.) allen Ernstes in ihre Grammatiken übernommen
relations.gloss_en: Later authors (Kielhorn, Fick, Morgenroth etc.) seriously adopted this into their grammars.

relations.subject: Ulrich Stiehl
relations.role: critic/opponent regarding Wezler's flawed revision of Stenzler's textbook
relations.evidence: Seine Bearbeitung 1995 als Resultat seines eigenen Lernens mit dem "Stenzler" enthält über 270 Fehler!
relations.gloss_en: Wezler's 1995 revision, the result of his own learning from 'Stenzler', contains over 270 errors.
